definitions.explanation: The academic study of China, covering its language, literature, history, thought, and culture.

Composed of ⟦{中国|ちゅうごく}→中国：28300_chuugoku⟧ (China) + the suffix ⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ (the study of). One of many academic fields named with the ～⟦{学|がく}→〜学：09846_gaku⟧ pattern.
